summary: The target lacks essential DNS records to prevent email spoofing and enforce email authentication policies, which could lead to phishing attacks. No open ports were found, but DNS-level security is crucial for overall protection.

findings.title: Missing SPF DNS Record
findings.why_it_matters: An SPF record helps prevent attackers from sending emails that appear to come from your domain, reducing the risk of phishing attacks.
findings.suggested_action:
Add an SPF record to your DNS configuration. Example:

`v=spf1 a mx ip4:YOUR_IP_RANGE include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all`

findings.title: Missing DMARC DNS Record
findings.exploitability: High risk of phishing and email fraud
findings.why_it_matters: A DMARC record helps enforce email authentication policies and provides reports on email authentication failures, reducing the risk of phishing and email fraud.
findings.suggested_action:
Add a DMARC record to your DNS configuration. Example:

`_dmarc TXT "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; sp=quarantine; rua=mailto:[email@example.com]; ruf=mailto:[email@example.com]; adkim=s; aspf=s;"""
